criteria.text: Calling the exported `onnx` scorer (e.g. `await onnx(text, person, persons)`) under an environment with `TESTIMONY_REVISION` unset rejects with an error whose message matches `/TESTIMONY_REVISION/`, and does so without ever reaching `@huggingface/transformers`'s `from_pretrained` — checkable by a test that stubs or spies nothing beyond `withEnv`, running under plain `pnpm test` with no network and no `KIKORI_CHECK`.
The same call under a `TESTIMONY_REVISION` value that fails `REVISION_TOKEN` (e.g. `'a b'`, `'a/b'`, `''` after defaulting) rejects with the same message pattern.

The rejection message text is identical, character for character, between `src/scorers/onnx.ts`'s guard and `src/score.ts`'s `resolveRun` guard — checkable by a test that imports both and compares the two literal strings (or asserts both against one shared regex/constant).

`resolveRun('onnx')` still throws synchronously before `migrateP()` is ever called when `TESTIMONY_REVISION` is unset or malformed — `test/score.test.ts:89-92`'s existing assertions keep passing unmodified; no new test is needed for this fact, only confirmation it still holds.

`pnpm typecheck` and plain `pnpm test` (no `KIKORI_CHECK`) pass with no network access attempted from `src/scorers/onnx.ts` at module scope or inside the new guard — the existing test at `test/scorers.test.ts` asserting `await import('../src/scorers/onnx.js')` resolves without invoking any model call keeps passing unmodified.
`KIKORI_CHECK=q8 TESTIMONY_REVISION=<valid> pnpm test` still passes (skipped by default; run manually or in CI's opt-in job) — confirms a correctly pinned load is unaffected by the new guard.

The docs state, somewhere across `README.md`/`docs/*.md` (via `docsText`, not tied to one page or heading): that the model cache keys files by revision only when one is given, so an unpinned load silently reuses whatever revision was first downloaded under that file name; and that the scorer itself, not only `pnpm score`, refuses to load without a pinned `TESTIMONY_REVISION`. Checkable by asserting both facts appear (by regex on content, not on a file path or heading) in `docsText`.
No criterion duplicates `test/docs-drift.test.ts`'s existing coverage — this issue touches no collector or source table, so no new criterion is written against `sourceTable`.
